title: Einstein submits his paper on special relativity
summary: Albert Einstein, a clerk at the Swiss patent office in Bern, submitted On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies to Annalen der Physik, setting out the theory of special relativity.
reason: Einstein sought to reconcile Maxwell's electromagnetism with the principle that the laws of physics are the same for all observers in uniform motion.
significance: Special relativity overturned absolute space and time and became a pillar of modern physics.
